metadata.label: Upper secondary school graduates who commenced higher education within one, three, five or ten years, by region, programme, sex, eligibility, and grades. Graduation year 2013/2014-2023/2024
note:
Commenced higher education programmes within 1, 3, 5, 10 years 
 Refers to registration in higher education programmes. This does not necessarily mean that the person has also started to study. 
 The statistics in this survey are presented net. This means that, for each individual, only one registration at a university or institute of higher education is counted. 
 Eligibility from upper secondary school  All upper secondary school graduates automatically have basic eligibility for an institute of higher vocational education. All graduates from preparatory programmes for post-secondary education automatically have basic eligibility for an institute of higher education. Graduates from vocational programmes can add subjects to obtain basic eligibility for an institute of higher education.  
 Municipality (residency)  The municipality in which the person resides is measured at 31 December of the academic year of graduation. For example, the municipality of residence for 2017/18 graduates is measured at 31 December 2017. Students for which no data is available regarding municipality have, in the vast majority of cases, undergone their upper secondary education abroad. 
 Municipality (upper secondary school)  The municipality in which the upper secondary school is located. Students for which no data is available regarding the municipality of the school have undergone their upper secondary education abroad. Students for which no data is available regarding municipality have, in the vast majority of cases, undergone their upper secondary education abroad. 
 Grade point average from upper secondary school Students who have studied in the International Baccalaureate programme do not obtain course grades on the same scale as students who have studied in other programmes, and are thus not included in the presentation according to grade points. 
 To prevent disclosure of information, random rounding off was applied in the tables.  Cell values 1 and 2 have been rounded off to either 0 or 3 with predetermined probabilities. This is why the study domains sometimes do not add up to the total.
